### Fixes

- The German plugin label reads "Carve für Shopware" again rather than an ASCII transliteration, and the German store changelog carries real umlauts throughout (#36)

### Improvements

- Gated file includes. An administrator sets an absolute include containment root, empty by default, which keeps every directive literal everywhere. With a root configured the `carve:render` command and the Carve CMS element expand includes, the CMS surface behind its own `carve.include_expand` privilege; product, category and manufacturer fields stay literal whoever wrote them. The administration preview now renders through a server route under the editor's own privileges, so it shows what the storefront produces (#35)
- Require carve-php 0.1.9 for the include pass, and lock the admin preview engine to carve-js 0.1.7 (#35)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/markup-carve/shopware-carve/compare/0.1.3...0.1.4
